messages:
emily_sales: ACME POC hitting 5xxs during ramp. They reported a spike at ~15:22 UTC when pushing to ~170rps. need a quick mitigation for the demo.
ryan_eng: what errors? 502/503/504 or model OOM?
zoe_support: mix of 502 and `ERR connection pool exhausted` in model logs. started at 15:22:10, peaked ~90s. client used client-side prefetch of cache.
mark_oncall: prefetch + concurrency often multiplies KV calls. If those are blocking we exhaust conn pools and runtime threads.
liam_sre: brief timeline:
```
15:21:50 - client ramp begin
15:22:15 - queue depth +350
15:22:40 - first 502s, redis timeouts
15:23:00 - autoscaler request
15:23:50 - new workers up, partial recovery
```
ryan_eng: autoscaler reacted but with ~30-40s lag. root cause appears to be synchronous prefetch causing many backend KV lookups per request and small conn pool on model side.
emily_sales: ACME says prefetch cut p99 in small tests. they want to keep it if possible. but demo needs to complete. any fast fixes?
mark_oncall: quick options: disable client prefetch (immediate), apply per-route concurrency cap (we can set concurrency=30), or temporarily increase redis/maxclients and model conn pool (ops change).
infra-bot: route-config queued id=rq-447, target=acme-poc, cap=concurrency:30
liam_sre: applied cap, telemetry shows queue depth falling and redis errors dropping within ~45s. 5xx rate returned to baseline.
zoe_support: I'll tell ACME to turn off prefetch for demo. Emily, can you confirm with them?
emily_sales: on call now, asking them to disable prefetch. will report back once they confirm.
ryan_eng: follow-ups: implement async/pipelined prefetch pattern, increase model conn pool, and tune autoscaler to handle short spikes faster. also add docs note about prefetch under high concurrency.
liam_sre: filing SRE-2102 (conn pool), SRE-2103 (autoscale fast-path).
zoe_support: billing note: prefetch that triggers extra requests can increase usage-based charges; I'll send ACME an estimate separately.
emily_sales: demo resumed, ACME happy. closing thread and will sync on action items. :white_check_mark:
